notes.text: Premier Brawl Ball pick: Super-based dashes carry the ball across the map in seconds without spending ammo, dribbling better than Mortis or Kenji.
Avoid maps heavy in water and walls — they interrupt the Super dash chain.
Heist threat: the full dash chain crosses the map to the safe from far range.
Engage pattern: poke to three notes first, then dash in with full damage rotation; keep one dash in reserve to exit area-scan Supers (Maisie, Frank).
